race.comment: SAVISANTA (4) drops back from stronger racing in Melbourne and Sydney, and has always hinted strong staying ability. Should be at his top now and benefits from the Waller-Maloney combo. DRAW ATTENTION (9) is the obvious danger after bringing up the hat-trick last time here. Has continued to raise the bar this prep and gets another chance to flex some muscle. Expect Thompson to take her straight to the front again. CIGAR MAN (2) is also in career-best tough and gets in well at the weights with Newman's 3kg claim. Not dismissing lightly. PROCHESTER (5) couldn't make it three on the trot last time but was far from disgraced in tough conditions. Is one of the contenders.
